title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: No low cloud on the slope (camera); a cloud layer is overhead. First clouds will form at about 3,700 ft, a little higher if the slope warms first; the night's dew is evaporating -- Kula Ag's dew point is up 2 °F since 05:30 and it is still 88% humid. Today's forecast: Thermals probably flat. No trade line is expected. Upslope has not set in yet.
